# Attestation Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AttestationType`](gmeow-AttestationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AttestationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of attestation being made — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinguishes SLSA provenance, in-toto attestation, VC, DSSE envelope, C2PA manifest, EAT token, signed RDF, SCITT statement, nanopublication, blockchain claim, git signed tag, release manifest, quality report attestation, and AI output attestation.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AttestationType`](gmeow-AttestationType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:attestationType`](../properties/gmeow-attestationType.md) — the open set of individuals naming the KIND of attestation (SLSA provenance, in-toto, VC, DSSE, C2PA, nanopublication, blockchain claim, git signed tag, AI output).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-type subclasses (types are individuals) and avoid using it for the concrete media type ([`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-artifactMediaType.md)) or the issuing policy ([`gmeow:AttestationPolicy`](gmeow-AttestationPolicy.md)); the type is the category, not the format or the framework.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded type individuals via the non-functional [`gmeow:attestationType`](../properties/gmeow-attestationType.md) (an attestation may carry several); mint new individuals rather than subclasses when a new attestation kind appears.

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:attestationType`](../properties/gmeow-attestationType.md) [`gmeow:attestationTypeSLSAProvenance`](../individuals/gmeow-attestationTypeSLSAProvenance.md).
